title: Ad Operations Specialist, TVAD
skills: Log Collection & Ingestion: Proactively collect Pre-logs and Post-logs from assigned television networks.
Operational Deadlines: Ensure all data is uploaded into the proprietary app by established weekly deadlines, primarily every Tuesday.
Parsing & Data Validation: Verify that spend and spot totals within the application match physical network logs to ensure accuracy and completeness of work.
Technical Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve technical discrepancies, such as duplicated logs, system errors, or inconsistencies between the app and the log.
Spot Reconciliation (Recon): Analyze post-logs against original media orders to identify erroneous airings.
Discrepancy Investigation: Flag and investigate common issues, including ads running during paid programming, incorrect creative assets (ISCI codes), or violations of spot separation rules.

Credit Memo & Financial Management: Exercise professional judgment to determine when to credit spots and manage the end-to-end Credit Memo process—from generation and network distribution to tracking through completion—to ensure final client invoices are accurate.
Liaison & Coordination: Serve as a point of contact for networks to understand clearance abnormalities and relay these to the buyers.
Progress Reporting: Manage progress reporting via project management tools (Jira) to keep stakeholders informed of the reconciliation status.

Process Improvement: Proactively identify areas for efficiency by spotting trends for automation to streamline redundant tasks within the reconciliation workflow, ultimately increasing overall team productivity and operational efficiency.
Some prior experience in marketing or advertising is preferred.
Demonstrated project management and exceptional organizational skills, with the ability to balance complex workflows and proactively prioritize tasks against tight weekly deadlines.
Exceptional attention to detail for matching complex spend figures, spot rates, and ISCI codes.
Experience with ad servers (e.g., CM360, Innovid) and familiarity with the ad serving process from request to impression.
Working knowledge of digital technicals, including VAST tags, HTML, and basic ad specs.
Experience in at least one core Ad Ops function: Creative QA, Asset Management, Trafficking, or Reporting.
Familiarity with various media types, including Audio, Video (CTV/OTT, OLV), and Display.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas, filtering, and pivot tables.
Analytical Problem-Solving: Aptitude for performing detailed research and analysis to resolve billing and delivery discrepancies.
Linear TV Concepts: Foundational understanding of Linear concepts, including Dayparts, Clearance inventory, Avails, and BVS watermarking.
Software Proficiency: Experience with Jira for task tracking and media buying/planning applications.
Adaptability & Initiative: A self-starter who adopts new processes quickly and suggests prioritization of work based on overall business needs.
Communication: Strong communication skills to effectively liaise between teams, partners, and networks.
description:
About the job

Who We Are

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

Your primary focus involves high-level coordination between internal Linear Buyers and external television networks to reconcile media spend and performance data. You will operate independently with minimal supervision, using your specialized expertise in Linear TV alongside a foundational understanding of digital ad serving to ensure seamless campaign execution and data integrity.

Log Collection & Ingestion: Proactively collect Pre-logs and Post-logs from assigned television networks.

Experience in at least one core Ad Ops function: Creative QA, Asset Management, Trafficking, or Reporting.

Competencies

Linear TV Concepts: Foundational understanding of Linear concepts, including Dayparts, Clearance inventory, Avails, and BVS watermarking.

title: Senior Shopify E-commerce Specialist (Revenue Growth Focus)
skills: Shopify Ecosystem Mastery: Deep, hands-on experience with Shopify Plus, including its architecture, native features, liquid code familiarity (preferred), and the app ecosystem (subscriptions, loyalty, upsells, and checkout extensions).

A/B Testing & Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Proven track record of designing, executing, and analyzing A/B and multivariate tests using tools like Optimizely, VWO or Replo to improve CR, AOV, and LTV.

Data Analytics & Advanced Reporting: Ability to build comprehensive revenue dashboards and attribution models. Expert-level proficiency with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Shopify Analytics, Google Ads and Microsoft Ads turning raw data into actionable business intelligence.

Store Performance & UX Optimization: Strong understanding of web performance metrics (Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile responsiveness) and user behavior tracking tools (Hotjar, Clarity) to identify and eliminate friction points in the funnel.

Seasonal Campaign Architecture: Experience planning and executing revenue-driving operations for high-traffic retail events (BFCM, Christmas, Summer Sales), including inventory sync logic, discount automation, and landing page deployment.
Tech Stack Integration: Ability to connect and align CRM/Email Marketing platforms (e.g., Klaviyo, Attentive) with Shopify to ensure seamless data flow and automated customer journeys.

Pricing and Promotions: Support the analysis and performance measurement of pricing strategies, discount campaigns, and promotional events across Shopify stores. Evaluate the revenue and margin impact of discounts, automatic discounts, and Shopify Scripts or Functions-based pricing rules. Maintain a structured record of all promotions run, their mechanics, their performance, and key learnings for future reference. Work with the commercial team to model the expected impact of upcoming pricing decisions before they go live. Monitor promotional cannibalization, basket composition changes, and new vs. returning customer behavior during and after campaigns.

Agency-Bred Agility & Multi-tasking: Thrives in fast-paced environments, with a proven ability to manage multiple client accounts, prioritize high-impact tasks, and adapt quickly to shifting e-commerce trends.
Data-Driven Mindset with a Business Lens: Doesn’t just look at metrics for the sake of it; possesses the ability to connect technical data points directly to revenue growth and ROI.
Strategic Problem Solving: A proactive mindset that anticipates bottlenecks (e.g., cart abandonment spikes, checkout errors) and designs structural solutions before they impact revenue.

Cross-Functional Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex data and technical jargon into clear, actionable insights for developers, designers, and stakeholders. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects without dropping the ball on reporting cadences.

Detail-Oriented & Quality-Driven: Meticulous approach to QA testing, ensuring that pricing rules, discount codes, and user flows work flawlessly before going live.

Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves)
Basic understanding of HTML/CSS/Liquid for quick front-end tweaks.
Experience with automated reporting tools/BI tools (like Looker Studio).

Exposure to customer lifecycle and retention metrics such as cohort analysis, repeat purchase rate, conversion rates and subscription performance.

What We Offer
A high-impact, high-visibility role with direct input into commercial decision-making.
A collaborative team environment where data is genuinely valued and acted upon.
Exposure to a broad Shopify store portfolio and a fast-moving ecommerce operation.
Flexible work arrangements and a culture that respects work-life balance.
Competitive compensation with performance-based upside.

title: La IA en el marketing inmobiliario
description:
About the job

La evolución de los hábitos de consumo, acelerada por la digitalización y potenciada por la pandemia, ha cambiado radicalmente la forma en que las personas buscan, evalúan y adquieren una vivienda o una inversión inmobiliaria. En este contexto, el marketing tradicional, basado en anuncios en portales, campañas genéricas o visitas físicas, resulta insuficiente. Aquí es donde la inteligencia artificial entra en juego, aportando personalización, eficiencia y análisis predictivo a una industria que necesita adaptarse rápidamente.

Uno de los mayores aportes de la IA al marketing inmobiliario es la segmentación eficiente del público objetivo. Gracias al análisis de grandes volúmenes de datos, podemos identificar patrones de comportamiento, preferencias y necesidades específicas de distintos perfiles de compradores. "Esto nos permite diseñar acciones de marketing hiperpersonalizadas, que se ajustan a las características reales de cada segmento, aumentando significativamente las probabilidades de conversión a ventas", matiza Antonio Ortiz, Director General de SAFTI España.

Otra área clave es la automatización del contenido visual. Hoy en día, el comprador exige experiencias inmersivas y realistas, antes incluso de agendar una visita. La IA permite generar recorridos virtuales, imágenes mejoradas por algoritmos, e incluso vídeos personalizados para cada cliente potencial, basados en sus preferencias detectadas. Estas herramientas han demostrado ser especialmente útiles para atraer compradores internacionales, con un gran incremento principalmente en zonas costeras, o aquellos que no pueden desplazarse fácilmente.

La analítica predictiva, basada en inteligencia artificial, representa otro salto cualitativo. Gracias a modelos de machine learning, ahora se puede predecir con un alto grado de precisión qué propiedades tienen mayor probabilidad de ser vendidas en un periodo determinado, qué precios son los más competitivos en una zona, e incluso detectar oportunidades de inversión antes de que se hagan evidentes para el mercado. Esta capacidad de anticipación es oro puro, sobre todo en un entorno tan competitivo como el inmobiliario.

Antonio Ortiz afirma que "no podemos dejar de mencionar el impacto que la IA está teniendo en la generación y gestión de leads, que gracias a la priorización automática de contactos, basada en el comportamiento y nivel de interés de los usuarios, los agentes que forman la red pueden enfocar sus esfuerzos en prospectos clientes, optimizando su tiempo y recursos".

Sin embargo, como toda tecnología disruptiva, la IA también plantea retos. El principal de ellos es la necesidad de adaptación cultural dentro de las empresas. No basta con adquirir las herramientas, es fundamental formar a los equipos, rediseñar procesos y, sobre todo, fomentar una mentalidad abierta al cambio. Y es que la implementación efectiva de la inteligencia artificial requiere liderazgo, visión estratégica y una inversión sostenida en innovación.

Asimismo, es muy importante tener en cuenta los límites éticos y legales que acompañan el uso de datos y algoritmos. La personalización no debe convertirse en invasión, ni la automatización en deshumanización. Por ello, hay que apostar por un enfoque híbrido, donde la tecnología potencia, pero no reemplaza el talento humano, pues la empatía, la capacidad de negociación y el conocimiento profundo del mercado siguen siendo insustituibles en un agente inmobiliario.

"La aplicación de la IA al marketing inmobiliario no solo es una ventaja competitiva, sino una necesidad para sobrevivir en un mercado cada vez más exigente y dinámico", concluye el Director de SAFTI España.

title: Influenciando Lucros: Marketing de Influência Transformando Marcas
description:
About the job

A internet mudou e o mercado está se adaptando aos novos interesses dos usuários. A alternativa de investir em marketing de influência veio como uma mão na roda para marcas de vários nichos, possibilitando segmentação assertiva, relevância e alcance. Com a crescente presença de influenciadores nas redes sociais, empresas de todos os tamanhos estão investindo no poder dessas figuras para promover seus produtos e serviços. Mas o que exatamente é o Influencer Marketing e por que vale a pena investir nessa estratégia? Neste artigo, vamos explorar os principais motivos para considerar o marketing de influência como parte essencial do seu plano de marketing.

Aumento do Alcance

Os influenciadores possuem uma base de seguidores leais e engajados. Ao colaborar com eles, as marcas podem ampliar significativamente seu alcance, atingindo novos públicos que talvez não fossem impactados por outras formas de marketing, quebrando o padrão da propaganda convencional e atingindo um potencial de qualificação de leads bem mais expressivo.

Engajamento Autêntico

Uma das maiores vantagens do marketing de influência é a autenticidade. Influenciadores têm uma relação de confiança com seus seguidores, o que significa que suas recomendações são vistas como genuínas. Esse engajamento autêntico é crucial para a construção de uma imagem de marca positiva, além das chances de construir um relacionamento da marca com o consumidor final através do influenciador.

Conteúdo de Qualidade

Influenciadores são especialistas na criação de conteúdo atrativo e relevante, pense que é a série ou séries que vocês mais gosta, sobre a vida de alguém que você se identifica.. Ao trabalhar com eles, as marcas podem se beneficiar de conteúdo de alta qualidade que ressoa com o público-alvo, aumentando a visibilidade e o impacto das campanhas, garantindo ainda um selo implícito de “modernidade e confiabilidade” por aderir a uma estratégia popularizada e bem aceita pelos usuários online em geral.

Segmentação de Público

Os influenciadores geralmente atuam em nichos específicos, o que permite uma segmentação de público altamente precisa. Isso significa que as marcas podem direcionar suas campanhas para grupos demográficos específicos, maximizando a relevância e a eficácia das suas mensagens. Desde a ascensão do tráfego pago, que permite segmentar o público alvo por demografia, comportamento e interesses, porém confiando a qualificação do lead totalmente ao criativo institucional, empresas têm se empenhado em produzir um material relevante para impulsionamento. Contudo, os mesmos benefícios atrelados a uma figura carismática, entretenimento e altas taxas de retenção podem ser muito mais interessantes para as marcas investidoras.

ROI (Retorno sobre Investimento)

Comparado a outras formas de marketing, o marketing de influência muitas vezes oferece um ROI superior. Com custos geralmente mais baixos do que campanhas publicitárias tradicionais e resultados mensuráveis, essa estratégia pode ser uma maneira eficiente de aumentar as vendas e a visibilidade da marca.

Dados de pesquisa apontam que apenas 0,23% do faturamento das empresas torna-se investimento para o marketing de influência. As empresas para as quais os participantes trabalham faturaram, em média, R$ 5,8 bilhões em 2022. Em 2023, as mesmas destinaram, em média, R$ 1,3 milhões para a categoria. Ou seja, a cada R$ 100 de faturamento, R$ 0,23 vai para o marketing de influência. As marcas investem mais em relações públicas (R$ 0,36) e marketing e publicidade (R$ 3,50).

Prova Social

Recomendações de influenciadores funcionam como prova social, um poderoso fator na decisão de compra dos consumidores. Quando uma figura respeitada e confiável endossa um produto, isso pode aumentar significativamente a confiança do consumidor e impulsionar as vendas. E para consolidar esse ponto, tudo conta! A figura carismática, o conteúdo direcionado, o público bem nichado. Os fatores culminam em uma probabilidade maior de altas taxas de retenção e conversão.

Tendências e Inovação

O marketing de influência é dinâmico e está sempre evoluindo com novas tendências. Em 2023, o orçamento para o marketing de influência foi dividido entre posts (67%), audiovisual (16%), áudio/podcast (8,2%), streaming (4,5%) e eventos (3,2%). Para 2024, os profissionais vão aumentar o investimento em posts (45%), eventos (42%), audiovisual (36%), áudio (33%) e streaming (19%). Ao investir nessa estratégia, as marcas podem se manter na vanguarda das inovações do mercado, adaptando-se rapidamente às mudanças e se mantendo relevantes.Em um mercado cada vez mais competitivo, investir em marketing de influência pode ser a chave para se destacar e construir uma conexão genuína com seu público-alvo. Ao aproveitar o poder dos influenciadores, as marcas não só aumentam seu alcance e engajamento, mas também se beneficiam de conteúdo de qualidade e segmentação precisa.

Sobre Palenca

Palenca está construyendo la infraestructura de verificación de ingresos del sistema financiero mexicano. La meta: que ningún crédito en México se otorgue sin pasar por nosotros.

Validar ingresos en México es difícil. Las fuentes están fragmentadas, son inconsistentes, y muchas veces fáciles de falsificar. Eso deja a millones de personas y a un universo enorme de empresas fuera del sistema crediticio aunque tengan ingresos comprobables.

Palenca lo resuelve. Con un solo CURP o RFC, entregamos un perfil de ingresos completo y consentido vía API a las instituciones financieras del país. Procesamos información de más de 10 millones de mexicanos y operamos bajo certificación ISO 27001 y LFPDPPP.

Pasamos por Y Combinator (S21) y hemos levantado $6.5M USD.




El rol

Estamos buscando al Director Comercial que va a construir desde cero nuestro motor ventas enterprise durante los próximos 18 meses.

About ATQLeads

ATQLeads is a U.S.-based Go-to-Market execution company that helps organizations design, build, and operate scalable growth systems.

We combine strategy, technology, AI-enabled workflows, and specialized GTM talent to help our clients execute across demand generation, marketing operations, sales development, automation, and revenue growth.




Through the ATQ Certified Operator Network, we identify, evaluate, and deploy experienced GTM professionals into client engagements based on their expertise, industry experience, technical capabilities, availability, and fit for each mission.




Operators in the network may receive access to ongoing client opportunities, ATQ training and certification programs, performance coaching, community support, and potential pathways into longer-term or full-time roles.







The Opportunity

ATQLeads is seeking an experienced Fractional Growth Marketer to support a U.S.-based SaaS company serving the financial services industry.




This is a remote contract engagement requiring approximately 20 hours per week.

The ideal candidate has experience developing and managing multi-channel growth campaigns for B2B SaaS companies, particularly those selling to:

Banks
Credit unions
Financial institutions
Financial services executives
Enterprise and mid-market buying committees




You will be responsible for connecting campaign strategy, messaging, content, nurture, paid media, webinars, landing pages, and performance insights into one coordinated growth system.




This is not a role focused only on producing marketing assets. You will be expected to understand the complete acquisition funnel, identify conversion opportunities, run structured experiments, and continuously improve campaign performance.







Key Responsibilities







Campaign Strategy and Messaging

Own the messaging angle and creative strategy for active campaigns.

Every campaign should launch with:

A clear growth hypothesis
A defined target audience
A relevant value proposition
A coordinated campaign message
Measurable conversion objectives




You will continuously refine messaging based on campaign data, market feedback, and audience engagement.







A/B Testing and Conversion Optimization

Develop and manage an ongoing experimentation program across active campaigns.

You will test elements including:

Subject lines
Value propositions
Calls to action
Creative concepts
Landing-page copy
Audience segments
Campaign offers
Nurture messaging




Winning variants should be documented, applied across channels, and scaled.







Funnel Audit and Ongoing Optimization

Begin the engagement by conducting a complete audit of the existing marketing and sales funnel.

Map conversion performance across the buyer journey, including:

First touch
Content engagement
Landing-page conversion
Lead capture
Nurture engagement
Sales activation
Meeting booked




Identify the most important drop-off points and develop an ongoing optimization plan to improve conversion at each stage.







Nurture Segmentation and Activation

Build tailored nurture journeys for different audience and account segments.

Create activation campaigns that move leads through the sales cycle using relevant content, timely messaging, and clear next steps.




Segmentation may include factors such as:

Institution type
Account size
Buyer persona
Engagement level
Campaign source
Funnel stage
Product interest







Webinar Planning and Execution

Own webinar campaigns from initial concept through post-event conversion.

Responsibilities include:

Topic selection
Audience definition
Registration-page messaging
Email promotion
LinkedIn promotion
Session structure
Speaker coordination
Attendee nurture
Post-event follow-up
Conversion reporting




Webinars should be managed as pipeline-generation programs rather than standalone events.







Content Amplification

Transform executive thought leadership and long-form content into coordinated campaign assets.

Repurpose content across:

Email campaigns
LinkedIn posts
Nurture sequences
Landing pages
Webinar promotions
Campaign messaging
Sales enablement assets




The objective is to maximize the reach, relevance, and commercial impact of every core content asset.







Landing-Page Creation and Optimization

Create dedicated landing pages for priority campaigns, including:

Webinars
Reports and downloadable resources
Product or solution campaigns
Account-based marketing initiatives
Lead-generation offers




Continuously improve landing-page conversion based on traffic, engagement, and conversion data.







Programmatic Display Strategy

Lead the setup and ongoing management of programmatic display campaigns.

You will be responsible for:

Defining audience segments
Developing campaign messaging

Reviewing engagement data

Cross-Channel Campaign Alignment

Ensure that outbound sequences, LinkedIn campaigns, company-page content, nurture tracks, webinars, landing pages, and display advertising communicate a consistent message to the same audience.




Prospects should experience one coordinated campaign across multiple touchpoints rather than a collection of disconnected marketing activities.







Performance Analysis and Feedback Loops

You will be expected to:

Identify patterns and conversion opportunities

Every campaign should generate learnings that improve future execution.

description:
About the job

I’m helping Decolure find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of DTC Operations Lead.




You'll drive DTC execution velocity and revenue growth by leading a data-driven team to ship impactful work.




Compensation:

USD 4K - 9K/month




Location:

Remote: Mexico




Mission of Decolure:

"We specialize in transforming a house into a home that the buyer is looking for, or a space that perfectly reflects your family’s style, needs and comfort (redesign)."




What makes you a strong candidate:

You are proficient in Shopify Plus, Shopify, Paid media, Meta Ads Manager, Linear.
You have +4 years experience in Direct-to-consumer marketing (DTC marketing).
English - Fully fluent




Responsibilities and more:

JOB TITLE: DTC Operations Lead

LOCATION: Remote

EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full Time




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a DTC Operations Lead to be the single owner of execution velocity for our Shopify direct-to-consumer channel. This is the most critical hire in our DTC buildout. We already have the strategy, the specs, the infrastructure, and the data — what we need is someone to make sure the work actually ships, every day, every week, without strategic conversations getting stuck in a document on Google Drive.

You will NOT be the person running ad accounts (that's the Growth Marketer). You will NOT be the person writing Liquid code (that's Implementation Specialist). You will NOT be the person producing creative assets (that's UGC Creators + Content Producer). Your job is to make sure ALL of those people are shipping, on-brief, on-time, every single week — and that the work they produce moves our DTC readiness score, revenue, and margin in the right direction.

This role is 70% execution management, 20% strategic decision-making, 10% hands-on analytical work. If you want to run ads or build pages yourself, this is not the right role. If you thrive on turning chaos into rhythm and watching a team ship more in a month than most DTC teams ship in a quarter, keep reading.




ABOUT US

Decolure is a US-based e-commerce company generating $18M+ annually on Amazon, with expanding presence on TikTok Shop and DTC Shopify. We operate 5 private label brands with 20+ active products across the portfolio.

What makes us different: we're building one of the most data-driven operations in the private label space. Our team uses advanced analytics, AI-powered operational agents, custom data pipelines, and structured decision frameworks to manage every aspect of the business , from keyword-level PPC decisions to inventory forecasting to competitive intelligence. This isn't a company where you'll be making gut calls. Every decision is backed by data, and every action plan has measurable outcomes.

We're a 27-person distributed team across the world. We operate in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment where ownership and accountability matter more than hours logged.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Execution Velocity & Team Management — 50% of your time

Daily standup (async or sync) with Growth Marketer, Implementation Specialist, UGC Creators — 15 minutes max, focused on "what shipped yesterday, what ships today, what's blocked"

ClickUp ownership: every open task has a clear owner, deadline, and acceptance criteria; every completed task has a tested outcome

Weekly sprint planning from the backlog of 17 existing specs + incoming priorities

Weekly sprint review: what shipped, what slipped, why, and what changes next week

Remove blockers: if Implementation Specialist is stuck on a Klaviyo flow, you unblock within 24 hours — you don't let it sit for a week

Pull from the AI agent's prioritized recommendations and assign — you should never have a team member wondering what to work on

DTC Performance Accountability — 20% of your time

Own the top-line DTC KPIs: revenue, conversion rate, CAC, AOV, email list growth, repeat purchase rate, contribution margin

Weekly performance review with the team, using data from the AI agent's dashboards

Monthly performance review with the CEO: what moved, what didn't, why, and what you're changing

Quarterly P&L review: contribution margin, LTV:CAC, channel profitability

Accountable for moving the DTC Readiness Tracker from 62% to 90% within 90 days of starting

Strategic Decision-Making — 20% of your time

Decide what the team works on this week, this month, this quarter — aligned with CEO priorities

Evaluate competing priorities: when the agent surfaces a conversion leak vs. the Growth Marketer wants to test a new creative vs. Ahmad has a blog CTA to ship, you prioritize

Approve or reject A/B test recommendations (with data justification)

Approve creative briefs before UGC creators start production

Cross-channel coordination: when Amazon runs a promotion, you decide DTC's response; when TikTok wants to test a creator, you validate the DTC implications

Escalate to CEO only what requires CEO-level decisions (budget above $500/day, pricing changes, strategic shifts) — you handle everything else

Hands-On Analytical Work — 10% of your time

Read dashboards daily — you should know the top 5 DTC metrics before your team tasks

Read Microsoft Clarity session recordings weekly (not optional) — you should know firsthand where users get stuck on mobile

Spot-check the AI agent's recommendations — verify the logic, don't just rubber-stamp

Identify when the AI agent is missing context and feed it back (this makes the agent better over time)

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (90-DAY SCORECARD)

Month 1 — Command of the Team

Daily standup rhythm established with all team members

ClickUp fully groomed: every open task has owner, deadline, acceptance criteria

Weekly sprint + review cadence operating

All 17 existing specs triaged and prioritized into a 12-week roadmap

First 5 specs shipped to production (not just drafted — LIVE)

You can verbally walk the CEO through current DTC performance, top risks, and this week's priorities in 5 minutes without notes

Month 2 — Execution at Pace

At least 10 specs shipped to production (cumulative from month 1)

DTC Readiness Tracker moved from 62% to 72%+

Store-wide conversion rate improved 0.2pp+ from baseline

Meta ROAS above 1.5x sustained

Email list growth accelerating (measurable WoW)

Zero specs older than 30 days sitting "in progress" — everything moves or gets killed

Month 3 — DTC Revenue Inflection

DTC revenue trajectory toward $30K+/month

DTC Readiness Tracker at 85%+

Blended ROAS above 2x sustained

CAC trending toward $15 target

Team is operating without needing daily direction — sprint cadence is self-sustaining

Clear strategic plan for months 4-6 submitted to CEO




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Must-Have Experience (Non-Negotiable):

4+ years leading DTC e-commerce operations (Shopify, BigCommerce, or direct Shopify Plus) at a brand doing $500K-$10M/year

Demonstrable track record of running a cross-functional DTC team: paid media, CRO, email, content, implementation

Experience managing remote teams across time zones (you will manage people in 2-4 countries simultaneously)

Project management fluency: ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Linear, Monday — doesn't matter which, but you must have run a real backlog, not a checklist

Data literacy: you can read GA4, Shopify Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Klaviyo, and Search Console fluently — not an expert in each, but competent enough to verify a specialist's work

Strong communication: written (async updates, briefs, escalation emails) and verbal (CEO check-ins, team standups)

Fluent English: written and verbal — this is a CEO-facing and team-leadership role

Strong Preferences:

Experience at a company running DTC alongside Amazon (cross-channel dynamics are a daily reality here)

Experience with bedding, home, wellness, or premium lifestyle brands

Experience working with AI tools as part of daily workflow (not just "used ChatGPT a few times")

Shopify Plus admin experience (not required, but a plus)

Klaviyo, Microsoft Clarity, Judge.me, Gorgias, or similar tool fluency

Nice-to-Have:

Background as a former Growth Marketer or CRO specialist (you understand what your team is doing at a technical level)

Experience in a 5-10 person company (you understand scrappy execution, not Fortune 500 bureaucracy)

Experience building or scaling a DTC channel from <$500K to $2M+ ARR

Comfort with light Shopify theme edits, basic HTML/Liquid (so you can spot-check work)




WHAT WE PROVIDE

A fully built strategic and data infrastructure: 17 specs, 86 processes documented, 35+ automation scripts, 13 active crons, all platform APIs integrated

An AI operations agent that delivers daily analytics, weekly summaries, competitor intel, creative briefs, PDP audit specs, email flow designs, and P&L analysis — you inherit a research and planning team on day 1

A 90-day playbook to move DTC Readiness from 62% to 90% — not a blank page

Direct CEO access for decisions above your authority level — clear escalation path, no middle-management bureaucracy

Growing revenue trajectory: DTC is our #1 strategic growth priority for 2026-2027

Clear promotion path: as DTC scales to $2M+ ARR, this role evolves into Head of DTC




DEAL-BREAKERS — DO NOT APPLY IF:

Your experience is primarily Amazon or marketplace operations — the playbooks don't transfer

You've only ever been an individual contributor (paid media specialist, CRO analyst) — this is a management role requiring team leadership

You've only ever led large teams (15+ people with clear functional silos) — this is a scrappy execution role where you lead 4-6 people across functions

You prefer strategy over execution — this is 70% execution, 20% strategy, 10% analysis

You need extensive direction from above — you will be given goals and scorecards, not task lists

You're uncomfortable delegating to an AI agent or receiving AI-generated specs — that's a core workflow of this role




WHAT YOU'LL GET

Competitive salary based on experience

Fully remote position. 

Direct access to the CEO. Your ideas and analysis reach the decision-maker, not a middle manager

Advanced tooling and infrastructure, including AI-powered analytics, custom dashboards, and automated reporting that let you focus on strategy instead of data entry

A team that values data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement

Opportunities for growth as the company expands into new marketplaces and channels

Employee discounts on Decolure products




Your potential leader(s):

Erik Fisher -



Desired Skills and Experience

Direct-to-consumer marketing (DTC marketing), Shopify Plus, Shopify, Paid media, Meta Ads Manager, Linear, Klaviyo, Growth marketing, Google Search Console, Data analysis

About the job

Overview

We are PepsiCo. We are game changers, mountain movers and history makers. We are a diverse group, spread among 200 countries and united by a shared set of values and goals.

That’s why we Perform with Purpose. Together, we blaze new trails, succeed, celebrate and never settle for second best. At PepsiCo, we’re committed to performing well as individuals and in teams, to strengthen the company as a whole.

Are you hungry to be a part of the World’s largest portfolio of billion dollar food and beverage brands? Then now is the time to explore the opportunities of PepsiCo: what makes you unique makes us better.

The Tech Strategy and Enterprise Products team within PepsiCo’s global Strategy and Transformation group is tasked with articulation of the vision, execution and implementation of PEP’s next generation global digital products and data infrastructure. The User Experience Design & Research team is not only responsible for software design solutions but will also be accountable for the resultant business improvement and outcomes.

Your role will be to be part of growing team based in Mexico City, Mexico, to create and support global digital developments for PepsiCo. These developments will be around topics like revenue management, supply chain, manufacturing, logistics.

You will be part of a collaborative interdisciplinary team within the User Experience Design & Research team, where you will be our system thinker, turning inputs into actionable strategies and designs. You will work closely with designers, process owners, product owners and final business users.

You will be an internal ambassador of the team’s culture around Product & UX Design. You will provide stewardship to colleagues in the areas that you are a specialist or you are specializing.

6+ years’ of experience designing digital products & services as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Experience with planning and conducting user research and user testing sessions including moderator guides to generate artifacts from synthesis.

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Technical Content Writer to work on a part-time basis. • Work with JSON-based data and ensure outputs are accurate and well-organized.

• Use Python scripting (as needed) to support data exploration, validation, and reproducible analysis.




Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Minimum 3+ years of relevant experience as a technical content writer, analyst, or software developer.

• Strong technical writing skills with experience producing clear, accurate, and structured content.

• Comfort working with data formats like JSON and interpreting datasets.

• Working knowledge of Python for data exploration/validation (not a core engineering role).

• Familiarity with notebooks and/or scripting workflows to support analysis and documentation.




More About the Opportunity:

This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Technology, Information and Internet industry, contributing to the transformation of AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence. The position emphasizes collaboration with top AI researchers and delivery of measurable impact.

title: Customer Service
description:
About the job

Sobre nosotros

Somos una empresa canadiense especializada en automatizar el fin de línea en procesos industriales. Ayudamos a nuestros clientes del sector manufacturero e industrial a mejorar su productividad, eficiencia y rentabilidad a través de soluciones técnicas de empaque, embalaje y automatización. Buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo a Costumer Service responsable de la Operación y Administración apasionado por la industria, con visión estratégica y alto enfoque comercial.




Objetivo del puesto

Garantizar la excelencia en el servicio postventa mediante la coordinación de servicios técnicos, el seguimiento operativo de los equipos instalados y la atención oportuna a los requerimientos de los clientes, como cotizaciones, venta de refacciones y solicitudes de servicio.




Requisitos del perfil




Carrera profesional terminada (Lic. en Negocios, Comercio Internacional, Relaciones Internacionales o afín).

Inglés avanzado.

Conocimiento deseable en empaque (Flejes, maquinas flejadoras, robots, etc)

Manejo de Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).

Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en servicio al cliente, preferentemente en empresas con enfoque industrial.

Conocimiento de operaciones de comercio exterior




Actividades principales




Gestionar la cotización y venta de refacciones y servicios.

Dar seguimiento y coordinar solicitudes de servicio técnico.

Gestión de la importación de refacciones.

Mantener comunicación constante con clientes antes, durante y después de cada intervención.

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Help us shape the future of food delivery in Mexico — one city at a time. As part of the Strategy BP team, you’ll be responsible for translating national priorities into actionable, high-impact strategies at the local level. You’ll work closely with City Managers and cross-functional teams to identify the biggest growth opportunities, focus execution, and drive real results across our most important regions

In this role, you'll be...


Serving as a key source of data-driven insights, supporting the Customer Success BP team in identifying and unlocking restaurant-level growth opportunities.

Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language (e.g., Python or R) for data analysis and visualization.

Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.

Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Interest in working with cross-functional teams and learning from stakeholder interaction.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. About the job

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Specialist, Customer Success

Overview

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution.

Delivering with excellence for our customers is of the utmost priority, and we are expanding our Services Customer Success team to achieve this goal. This team plays a crucial role in ensuring our customers achieve their desired outcomes while maximizing the value of our products and services. Customer Success (CS) boosts Customer Lifetime Value, increases renewals and adoption, reduces support tickets, improves product feedback, builds advocacy for B2B marketing, and generates qualified sales leads.

This team will work collaboratively with cross-functional partners to address customer needs, develop tailored strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and retention, and build customer advocacy. Key outcomes of the CS team’s work will be qualified leads for value expansion and feedback for product and process improvements. By focusing on proactive engagement and personalized service, the Services Customer Success team fosters long-term relationships and contributes to the overall growth and safety of the Mastercard ecosystem.

 As a Specialist, Customer Success for Services, you will support the development and delivery of strategic priorities within the region. The candidate will focus on ensuring the priority customers and segments they work with experience positive change through more effective use of Services network products. The candidate will support senior Customer Success Managers and work closely with cross-functional teams including Network Services, Account Management, Sales, Product, Technical Account Managers and support/delivery teams to realize the full value proposition of Mastercard Network Products on behalf of the customer.

The three areas of primary responsibility include: 1) customer engagement, 2) growing the business, and 3) technical and program readiness.

Customer Engagement:


 Engage with stakeholders to study the viability of proposed solutions and understand cyber threats in financial and payment sectors
 Identify optimization opportunities for customers with the goals of driving customer value and enhanced strategic goals through our products
 Articulate key performance indicators related to cost, performance and optimization and the insights associated with them



Growing The Business:


 Leverage Mastercard Services’ offerings to achieve customer goals and realize value propositions of Mastercard products
 Identify opportunities for additional Mastercard products to create greater value potential for customers and enhance impact of Network Product offerings
 Ability to evaluate business models, partnerships, and agreements ensuring product business cases are financially viable and supported by solid data



Technical & Program Readiness:


 Develop training materials, thought leadership, and customer-facing playbooks that can be scaled internally and externally to support customer priorities and Customer Success value proposition
 Translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner
 Gather and report customer feedback on product gaps and pain points. Use stakeholder insights to refine value propositions and improve products



All About You:


 Experienced at leveraging insights from market analysis, customer engagements, and identified opportunities to inform strategic decisions, drive innovation, and sustain competitive advantage
 Knowledge and understanding of payments technology or cybersecurity (threat intelligence or risk management) and application of that knowledge to address customer/market needs in these areas are a plus
 Experience using tools and technology to provide data analytics and business intelligence on cyber threats, fraud, risk and vulnerability
 Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner
 Experience in analyzing customer metrics and leveraging data to drive customer success initiatives that contribute to mutual profitability and growth
 Experience in identifying “next opportunity” for customers to further enhance the strength and value of the partnership for both parties
 Experience in creative thinking and development of innovative solutions to complex customer challenges
 Enthusiastic individual who works seamlessly with a diverse high performing team, nurtures a winning and inclusive culture, and a focus on development at the individual and team level
 Experience working with at least some of the following: large and emerging Technology, Financial Services, Acquirers/Processors, Service Providers, and/or digital platform partners
 Languages - English and Spanish; Portuguese desirable



Corporate Security Responsibility

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:


Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Hearth is the AI growth system for local home improvement small businesses. We build revenue-critical software for home improvement contractors — the roofers, HVAC techs, and builders who keep America running.

Our platform helps real business owners win more jobs, protect profit margins, and manage homeowner relationships professionally so they can build generational companies for their families and communities.

We are now building the next layer: a personal AI employee for every small business in the trades focused on autonomously generating sales for America’s home improvement pros. An assistant who answers every call 24/7, qualifies leads, books appointments, follows up on quotes and estimates, and helps small business owners go from missing half of their business to capturing all of it.

skills: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
description:
About the job

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Specialist, Customer Success

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution.

Delivering with excellence for our customers is of the utmost priority, and we are expanding our Services Customer Success team to achieve this goal. This team plays a crucial role in ensuring our customers achieve their desired outcomes while maximizing the value of our products and services. Customer Success (CS) boosts Customer Lifetime Value, increases renewals and adoption, reduces support tickets, improves product feedback, builds advocacy for B2B marketing, and generates qualified sales leads.

This team will work collaboratively with cross-functional partners to address customer needs, develop tailored strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and retention, and build customer advocacy. Key outcomes of the CS team’s work will be qualified leads for value expansion and feedback for product and process improvements. By focusing on proactive engagement and personalized service, the Services Customer Success team fosters long-term relationships and contributes to the overall growth and safety of the Mastercard ecosystem.

 As a Customer Success Sr. Specialist for Services, you will support the development and delivery of strategic priorities within the region. The candidate will focus on ensuring the priority customers and segments they work with experience positive change through more effective use of Services network products. The candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams including Network Services, Account Management, Sales, Product, Technical Account Managers and support/delivery teams to realize the full value proposition of Mastercard Network Products on behalf of the customer.

The three areas of primary responsibility include: 1) customer engagement, 2) growing the business, and 3) technical and program readiness.

Customer Engagement:

Engage with stakeholders to study the viability of proposed solutions and understand cyber threats in financial and payment sectors

Identify optimization opportunities for customers with the goals of driving customer value and enhanced strategic goals through our products

Articulate key performance indicators related to cost, performance and optimization and the insights associated with them

Growing The Business:

Leverage Mastercard Services’ offerings to achieve customer goals and realize value propositions of Mastercard products

Identify opportunities for additional Mastercard products to create greater value potential for customers and enhance impact of Network Product offerings

Ability to evaluate business models, partnerships, and agreements ensuring product business cases are financially viable and supported by solid data

Technical & Program Readiness:

Develop training materials, thought leadership, and customer-facing playbooks that can be scaled internally and externally to support customer priorities and Customer Success value proposition

Translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner

Gather and report customer feedback on product gaps and pain points. Use stakeholder insights to refine value propositions and improve products

All About You:

Experience managing clients or internal stakeholders

Logical, structured thinking, and affinity for numerical analysis

Experienced at leveraging insights from market analysis, customer engagements, and identified opportunities to inform strategic decisions, drive innovation, and sustain competitive advantage

Knowledge and understanding of payments technology or cybersecurity (threat intelligence or risk management) and application of that knowledge to address customer/market needs in these areas are a plus

Experience using tools and technology to provide data analytics and business intelligence on cyber threats, fraud, risk and vulnerability

Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner

Experience in analyzing customer metrics and leveraging data to drive customer success initiatives that contribute to mutual profitability and growth

Experience in identifying “next opportunity” for customers to further enhance the strength and value of the partnership for both parties

Experience in creative thinking and development of innovative solutions to complex customer challenges

Enthusiastic individual who works seamlessly with a diverse high performing team, nurtures a winning and inclusive culture, and a focus on development at the individual and team level

Experience working with at least some of the following: large and emerging Technology, Financial Services, Acquirers/Processors, Service Providers, and/or digital platform partners

English and Spanish (Portuguese highly desirable)

Corporate Security Responsibility

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:


Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

About the job

Description

Amazon Mexico's Media Retail team is looking for a data driven, customer-obsessed, hands on and creative candidate to join our team. As a Brand Specialist, you'll own selected brands to help drive growth and help deliver a best-in-class customer experience on Amazon.com.mx, while facilitating great business relationships with some of Amazon's highest visibility brands.

Key job responsibilities

You'll be responsible for looking after the brands' product portfolio, contributing to improvements in the user experience for customers and creating detailed weekly reports on performance. You'll lead presentations and planning sessions with vendors and act as the main point of contact for them.

You will also provide support to drive business growth through detailed analysis of business inefficiencies and identifying solutions; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high-quality product detail pages; and making recommendations for effective marketing campaigns.

To achieve success in this role, you will have strong analytical and relationship management skills. You are comfortable picking up new technologies and skills quickly. You'll be a problem solver, identifying issues or opportunity areas to then create plans to drive improvement.

 Online marketing: improving product page data, developing marketing and merchandising plans, improving customer experience onsite, helping generating traffic and sales
 Vendor management: help growing selection of products to sell on Amazon, onboarding new vendors, identifying and resolving pricing issues
 In-stock management: tracking purchase orders, investigating late deliveries, resolving order rejections, working with vendors on PO automation.

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

 1+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience
 Experience using analytical specific tools such as Google Analytics, SQL or HTML

 Speak, write, and read fluently in English

 Experience in process improvement

Operating in the beauty and wellness industry, they offer premium skincare products inspired by Traditional Chinese Medicine alongside educational content, online courses, and clinical services that empower women to achieve healthier skin through science-backed solutions. As the company continues to scale, they are seeking a Performance Marketing Lead to drive customer acquisition, optimize conversion rates, and accelerate online revenue growth.




Role Overview

The Performance Marketing Lead will initially focus on Meta advertising, Shopify optimization, and funnel improvements before expanding into broader e-commerce leadership, including agency management and team growth. About The Role

At Essity, we are looking for a Customer Marketing Activation Manager to join the Tork Customer Marketing team, leading the execution of commercial and marketing strategies aimed at driving business growth through our distribution channels.

Tork, an Essity brand, is the global leader in professional hygiene solutions. Serving customers across industries such as healthcare, foodservice, manufacturing, offices, and commercial facilities, Tork provides products, services, and digital solutions designed to improve hygiene standards, operational efficiency, and sustainability. Through innovation and customer-centric solutions, Tork helps businesses create better experiences while driving growth and performance.

Customer Marketing at Tork plays a critical role in accelerating growth by connecting strategy with sales. The team works across functions to transform business priorities into effective market execution, ensuring commercial excellence through distributor engagement, brand activation, portfolio implementation, training, and demand generation initiatives.

The main focus of the position is to lead brand activations, distributor programs, sales training initiatives, events, product launches, and portfolio execution projects, ensuring successful implementation aligned with the company’s commercial objectives.

About the job

Este es un puesto de trabajo remoto.

Buenas,

Somos Ekalon.

Si estás leyendo esto, probablemente tienes experiencia en paid media.

Vamos a explicarte qué buscamos exactamente, porque esta no es una posición estándar.

Lo primero que debes saber sobre Ekalon y cómo trabajamos

En Ekalon trabajamos para que profesionales de LATAM accedan a mejores oportunidades laborales en empresas internacionales, de forma remota.

Somos un equipo de más de 30 personas distribuidas en distintos países.

Llevamos años trabajando en remoto, con sistemas y herramientas (como Zoho y otros sistemas internos) que nos permiten tener claridad total sobre qué hay que hacer, cómo hacerlo y qué se espera de cada persona.

Aquí no hay jefes encima tuyo.

Pero sí hay algo más importante:

responsabilidad, autonomía y foco en resultados.

Estamos en crecimiento, y cada persona que entra tiene impacto directo en el negocio.

Si eres de los que quiere aportar, crecer y trabajar con libertad real, esta posición te va a gustar.

Importante

Estamos buscando a alguien que sume, que aporte y con quien dé gusto trabajar.

Nos tomamos muy en serio los valores de la empresa.

No están para decorar, están para construir un equipo de alto rendimiento.

Valores base:

1- Humildad: Para aceptar que siempre hay algo que no sabemos y en lo que podemos mejorar.

2- Hambre: Para tener ganas de ser mejores personas y profesionales con esfuerzo y dedicación.

3- Empatía: Para entender y ayudar a nuestros compañeros

Valores medulares:

1- Actitud ganadora: Entusiasmo, optimismo y resolutivo

2- Implicados: Conseguimos la máxima calidad y responsabilidad en nuestro trabajo = entregamos tareas en tiempo y forma

3- Trabajamos en equipo: hacemos equipo, empatizamos con el equipo

4- Nos gusta nuestro trabajo: Creemos una empresa de la que nos sintamos orgullosos, nos guste trabajar en ella y que sume y no reste en nuestra vida personal

5- Transparencia: comunicación, confianza en poder hablarlo todo aunque no nos guste lo que se vaya a decir

6- Cuidemos de Ekalon y Ekalon cuidará de nosotros

Si esto no resuena contigo, esta posición no es para ti.

El rol

No es solo un rol de ejecución.

Vas a crear y gestionar campañas, pero lo importante es tu capacidad de tomar decisiones y generar resultados.

Es un rol de responsabilidad sobre la adquisición de clientes.

Tu objetivo será hacer crecer el negocio a través de campañas publicitarias.

Objetivo del rol

Escalar la captación de clientes en mercados europeos (España, Italia, Francia y Andorra) de forma rentable, optimizando CAC y maximizando el ROAS.

Qué harás


Definir la estrategia de adquisición de clientes 
Crear, gestionar y optimizar campañas en Meta Ads y Google Ads 
Analizar métricas clave (CAC, ROAS, CPL, conversión) 
Tomar decisiones basadas en datos 
Detectar oportunidades reales de crecimiento 
Proponer nuevas ideas, tests y enfoques 
Coordinar mejoras en el funnel (no solo campañas) 
Reportar resultados con claridad 


Nivel esperado en este rol

Esperamos que hayas trabajado con métricas de negocio como CAC, ROAS o volumen de adquisición, y que entiendas cómo tus decisiones impactan directamente en resultados.

Este no es solo un rol de ejecución.

Buscamos a alguien que piense, ejecute y se haga responsable del resultado.

Si tu experiencia se limita a gestionar campañas sin responsabilidad sobre estos resultados, este rol no es para ti.

Con qué recursos contarás

That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues 
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience 
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features 
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate 
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization 
Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe 
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
You excel in critical thinking and problem solving
You have prior experience in customer service or internal and external user-facing operations
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes, you're an organized, self-starter with passion for finding solutions to our user’s challenges
You have a process-oriented mindset and the ability to get things done
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support
You prioritize well and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners
You're willing to periodically work a weekend day for which you'll receive a weekday off. The SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening



Preferred Qualifications


* Prior experience or knowledge in user support
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives 

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

description:
About the job

Who You’ll Work With

At Slalom we co-create custom software, data and cloud products with clients who are ready to accelerate their digital transformation. We’re passionate about technology, compelled by its potential as we help create the digital products, experiences, and technology-driven organizations that drive true change. We’re thrilled by the opportunity to build the future we want to see, with anyone willing to join us. Slalom’s Experience Design (XD) team is a group of diverse individuals who happen to be world-class multidisciplinary designers. We’re artists and technologists, sure. But we’re also athletes and farmers, carpenters and musicians, educators and data nerds, and so much more. 
 
Our growing team works closely with US and Canadian clients on complex, industry-heavy products across sectors including financial services, energy, and beyond. Together, we operate with a shared passion for building great products with great clients. Our recent expansion into Latin America has further enriched our team with diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. We are open to hiring either the Consultant (Sr. Product Designer) or Senior Consultant (Lead Product Designer) level title. 

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Designer on the Customer Experience team, you'll independently turn product requirements into high-fidelity, production-ready design for complex products in industries like financial services, energy, and enterprise technology. You'll work within established product ecosystems and existing design systems, contributing improvements as you go, and bring real craft and polish to the screens, flows, and interactions that move products forward.

Day to day, you'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with developers, product and project managers, fellow designers, and on larger engagements, design leads, translating requirements into clear, development-ready design artifacts. You'll communicate your design decisions to the team and client stakeholders, share progress in working sessions, and ask the right questions to make sure what you're designing lines up with what the client actually needs.

You'll use modern prototyping and agentic design tools to communicate intent quickly and keep design, engineering, and product aligned around a single source of truth. You'll manage your own workload and velocity with minimal oversight, anticipate and flag delivery risks early, and operate independently when the path is clear, pulling in guidance from leads when the problem space is less defined.

As you grow, you'll start connecting your work to the client's near-term goals and contribute back to Slalom's design practice through reusable patterns and shared craft, strengthening both the engagement in front of you and the team around you. 

What You’ll Bring

Senior Designers at Slalom bring strong design craft, the independence to own their own scope of work, and the experience to deliver high-polish design within real-world product environments — not just clean-slate builds. You translate defined requirements into clear, high-fidelity design, collaborate closely across delivery teams, and hold a high-quality bar on everything you ship. To meet these expectations, you'll need:

4+ years of experience in product design or UX design — experience in professional services or consulting a plus
A portfolio demonstrating strong design craft, attention to detail, and high-fidelity execution across multiple product types (web, native, and/or others)
Proven ability to independently turn requirements into production-ready design with minimal oversight
Experience working on complex, industry-heavy products (e.g., financial services, energy, enterprise platforms) not just consumer or marketing-focused work
Comfort working within existing design systems and contributing to them, including in evolving or inconsistent system environments
Fluency in modern product design software (Figma, Framer, etc.) and familiarity with agentic design and prototyping tools (Figma Make, Lovable, Claude Design, etc.)
Professional English fluency, with the ability to communicate design decisions and progress clearly to US and Canadian client teams

About Us

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.

What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.



Desired Skills and Experience

Bar, Consulting, Customer Experience, Design, Design Systems, Detail-oriented, Energy, Engineering, English, Figma, Financial Services, Framer, Polish, Product Design, Product Requirements, Professional Services, Professionalism, Prototyping, Software, Source, Technology, User Experience Design

description:
About the job

Posición presencial en Guadalajara.




En Métrica Móvil estamos armando el motor comercial de la operación en occidente desde cero. Ya tenemos producto (telemetría, videotelemática y soluciones de gestión de flotas), y ahora falta la pieza que abre cuentas, empuja el deal y lo cierra en el occidente del país. Ese eres tú.




Al inicio no vas a esperar a que te lleguen leads servidos. Vas a salir a buscar negocio con tus propios contactos y tu propia lectura del mercado regional, mientras la maquinaria de SDR termina de arrancar en los próximos meses. Es una posición para alguien que sabe abrir puertas, no solo administrar un inbox.




¿Por qué buscamos este rol?

La operación en occidente creció y ya no basta con atender lo que cae. Se separó la parte gerencial y administrativa (que hoy tiene otra persona) para dejar este puesto 100% enfocado en desarrollo de negocio y cierre. Es un rol comercial puro, sin la carga gerencial que tenía antes: tú vendes, tú cierras, tú haces crecer la cartera de la región.




¿Qué hay para ti?

Vas a tener ownership real de la cartera de occidente. No entras a heredar un pipeline lleno ni a ejecutar el playbook de alguien más; entras a construirlo. Eso significa que tu criterio pesa: cómo priorizas cuentas, cómo abres una flotillera, cómo estructuras una propuesta de telemetría, es tuyo.

Vas a vender un portafolio sólido (telemetría, videotelemática, hardware y software de gestión de flotas) en una empresa estructurada, no en un experimento. Si vienes de un player grande donde vendías el mismo tipo de solución pero con menos margen de maniobra, aquí te vas a remangar y vas a ver el impacto de tu trabajo directamente en la cuenta.

Y trabajas de la mano del SDR desde el día uno: conforme esa parte madure, vas a recibir oportunidades calificadas mientras tú te concentras en cerrar. Es una posición pensada para que crezcas con la operación regional.




Qué harás

Prospectar y abrir cuentas B2B en la región occidente.
Vender telemetría, videotelemática y soluciones de gestión de flotas a áreas de logística y transporte.
